svg.title: How a job of the pager runs
svg.desc: You press Draft a reply or Start fix, or write a text, and the pager's Worker sends an event to this private repository. The job prepare checks the event and collects what Claude reads, with the read-only token of the workflow. The job ask runs Claude Code with your subscription on the egress-firewall runner; Claude only reads, and in a fix edits a checkout. For a fix with a change, the job pull-request opens a pull request with PAGER_FIX_TOKEN, on another machine. The job answer checks Claude's answer against the allowlist and sends it to the Worker, signed. The Worker shows it in Telegram: a draft with Send, a note, or a proposal with one Confirm button, which acts only when you press it.
